reading: Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelensky, spoke to the BBC in Kyiv.
He said the US was paying too much attention to the Middle East.
He wants the US to push Russia harder during peace talks.
The aim of these talks is to end the war between Russia and Ukraine.
The latest peace talks made no clear progress.
Zelensky said he expected talks to start again in December.
Some businesses in Kyiv have closed because power cuts and attacks have made their costs too high.
Some people have already left the city for the winter.
Zelensky said Ukraine would try to defend its capital.

vocabulary.definition: Careful thought about someone or something.
Meetings where people try to agree on ending a war.
Begin one more time after stopping.
Times when homes and other buildings have no electricity.
The city where a country's government works.
